# App Store location permission rejection (2026-01-14 18:33Z)

_**User**_

I have submitted this app but it was rejected with this explanation:

Hello,

Thank you for submitting an update to the app, Miataru Location Share, for review. We noticed some issues that require your attention. Please see below for additional information.

If you have any questions, we are here to help. Reply to this message in App Store Connect and let us know.


Review Environment

Submission ID: 321c5565-d6e5-497b-b7e5-6c4bb3b1f395
Review date: January 14, 2026
Review Device: iPad Air 11-inch (M3)
Version reviewed: 2.7.6


Guideline 5.1.1 - Legal - Privacy - Data Collection and Storage


The app encourages or directs users to allow the app to access the location. Specifically, the app directs the user to grant permission in the following way(s):

- A custom message appears before the permission request, and to proceed users press a "Enable Location Tracking" button. Use words like "Continue" or "Next" on the button instead.

Permission requests give users control of their personal information. It is important to respect their decision about how their data is used.

Next Steps

To resolve this issue, please revise the permission request process in the app to not display messages before the permission request with inappropriate words on buttons.

If necessary, you may provide more information about why you are requesting permission before the request appears. If the user is trying to use a feature in the app that won't function without access to the location, you may include a notification to inform the user and provide a link to the Settings app.

Resources

- Learn more about data collection and storage requirements in guideline 5.1.1.
- Learn more about designing appropriate permission requests.

Properties\n    @Published var disableDeviceAutolock: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(disableDeviceAutolock, forKey: Keys.disableDeviceAutolock) }\n    }\n    @Published var indicateAccuracyOnMap: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(indicateAccuracyOnMap, forKey: Keys.indicateAccuracyOnMap) }\n    }\n    @Published var groupsZoomToFit: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(groupsZoomToFit, forKey: Keys.groupsZoomToFit) }\n    }\n    @Published var miataruServerURL: String {\n        didSet {\n            defaults.set(miataruServerURL, forKey: Keys.miataruServerURL)\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncWidgetConfig(\n                serverURL: miataruServerURL,\n                deviceIDs: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.map { $0.DeviceID },\n                ownDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var trackAndReportLocation: Bool {\n        didSet { \n            defaults.set(trackAndReportLocation, forKey: Keys.trackAndReportLocation)\n            // Check location permissions when tracking is enabled\n            if trackAndReportLocation {\n                checkAndRequestLocationPermissions()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var saveLocationHistoryOnServer: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(saveLocationHistoryOnServer, forKey: Keys.saveLocationHistoryOnServer) }\n    }\n    @Published var locationDataRetentionTime: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(locationDataRetentionTime), forKey: \"location_data_retention_time\") }\n    }\n    @Published var mapType: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapType), forKey: Keys.mapType) }\n    }\n    @Published var mapUpdateInterval: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapUpdateInterval), forKey: Keys.mapUpdateInterval) }",

        "contents": "    private func updateTrackingMode() {\n        let state = UIApplication.shared.applicationState\n        let status = locationManager.authorizationStatus\n startSignificantChangeUpdates()\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Ensure updates are stopped but preserve user's tracking preference flag\n  // Legacy @AppStorage fields removed in favor of RouteRequestCounter\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        ScrollView {\n            VStack(spacing: 16) {\n            // Status-Header\n         "contents": "    private func updateTrackingMode() {\n        let state = UIApplication.shared.applicationState\n        let status = locationManager.authorizationStatus\n        debugLog(\"updateTrackingMode called, state: \\(state.rawValue), status: \\(status.rawValue), isTracking: \\(isTracking)\")\n        switch status {\n        case .authorizedAlways, .authorizedWhenInUse:\n            if isTracking {\n                if state == .active {\n                    startHighAccuracyUpdates()\n                } else {\n                    startSignificantChangeUpdates()\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Ensure updates are stopped but preserve user's tracking preference flag\n                stopHighAccuracyUpdates()\n                stopSignificantChangeUpdates()\n            }\n        case .notDetermined:\n            // Do not reset isTracking while the user has not decided yet\n            break\n        case .denied, .restricted:\n            // Explicitly stop tracking if permission is denied/restricted\n            stopTracking()\n        @unknown default:\n            stopHighAccuracyUpdates()\n            stopSignificantChangeUpdates()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func startHighAccuracyUpdates() {\n        debugLog(\"Calling startHighAccuracyUpdates\")\n        locationManager.allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates = false\n        debugLog(\"allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates set to false (foreground)\")\n kCLDistanceFilterNone\n        locationManager.startUpdatingLocation()\n        if foregroundLocationTimer == nil {\n            debugLog(\"App is active, will start foreground location timer\")\n            startForegroundLocationTimer()\n        } else {\n            debugLog(\"Foreground location timer already running\")\n        }\n    }\n    \n    func startSignificantChangeUpdates() {\n        debugLog(\"startSignificantChangeUpdates called\")",

        "contents": "    \n    @objc private func appDidBecomeActive() {\n        debugLog(\"App did become active\")\n        // Re-check permission escalation / first-time prompt if needed\n        ensureAuthorizationIfNeeded()\n        if isTracking {\n            startHighAccuracyUpdates()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Settings Observer\n    private func observeSettings() {\n        settings.$trackAndReportLocation\n            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink { [weak self] shouldTrack in\n                guard let self else { return }\n                if shouldTrack {\n                    self.startTracking()\n                } else {\n                    self.stopTracking()\n                }\n            }\n            .store(in: &amp;cancellables)\n    }\n    \n    private func observeActivityType() {\n        settings.$locationActivityType\n            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink { [weak self] newValue in\n                guard let self = self else { return }\n                self.locationManager.activityType = Self.activityTypeFrom(newValue)\n                if self.isTracking {\n                    // Restart location updates to apply new activityType immediately\n                    self.updateTrackingMode()\n                }\n            }\n            .store(in: &amp;cancellables)\n    }\n    \n    private static func activityTypeFrom(_ value: Int) -&gt; CLActivityType {\n        switch value {\n        case 1: return .automotiveNavigation\n        case 2: return .fitness\n        case 3: return .otherNavigation\n        case 4:\n#if swift(&gt;=5.0)\n            if #available(iOS 12.0, *) {\n                return .airborne\n            } else {\n                return .other\n            }\n#else\n            return .other\n#endif\n        default: return .other\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Permissions",
